root_cause.text: The driver incorrectly used the base DMA address (dma_addr) for cache synchronization instead of the actual hardware write offset (dma_addr + MVPP2_SKB_HEADROOM), causing the sync to cover unused headroom and miss the packet tail, leading to stale cache data on non-coherent systems.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "hardware writes received data at dma_addr + MVPP2_SKB_HEADROOM" while "the current CPU sync starts at dma_addr and only covers rx_bytes + MVPP2_MH_SIZE bytes, which syncs the unused headroom and misses the same number of bytes at the packet tail." The patch diff changes `dma_sync_single_for_cpu` to `dma_sync_single_range_for_cpu` with offset `MVPP2_SKB_HEADROOM`, correcting the sync range.
